criticalFindings.bugSummary: The automation script in purchase-order.page.js method openSearch() uses getByRole('button', { name: 'Open Search' }) which does NOT match the SAP Fiori shell bar search button. The correct locator is [title="Open Search"] (CSS attribute selector).
criticalFindings.whyItFails: Playwright's getByRole() uses accessibility tree lookups. SAP Fiori shell bar search button is rendered with role=button but does NOT have accessible name 'Open Search' — instead, it has an HTML title attribute. The accessibility tree does not expose this as the accessible name.
criticalFindings.sapImplementationDetail: SAP UI5 shell bar uses <button title="Open Search"> — a button with a title attribute instead of aria-label or explicit accessible name.
criticalFindings.fixDetails: Change from getByRole('button', { name: 'Open Search' }) to page.locator('[title="Open Search"]')
criticalFindings.riskOfFix: LOW — CSS attribute selector is more stable and specific than role-based for this UI5 element

sapBehaviorObservations.loginFlow: Two-step IDP (email → Continue → password → Continue) works as expected. SAP_USERNAME and SAP_PASSWORD from .env are correct.
sapBehaviorObservations.guidedTourPresence: Guided Tour dialog ALWAYS appears on login — must be dismissed.
sapBehaviorObservations.searchFunction: Search opens immediately when [title="Open Search"] clicked. Results appear in a dropdown grid. Keyboard navigation (ArrowDown + Enter) works to select results.
sapBehaviorObservations.appNavigation: Once search result selected, app opens in new context (URL hash changes to #PurchaseOrder-manage). Page takes 2-3 seconds to fully load.
sapBehaviorObservations.createPoButton: Button is enabled on app list page. Clicking opens a new draft PO form.
sapBehaviorObservations.draftMode: New PO created immediately in draft mode (IsActiveEntity=false). URL shows draft UUID.
sapBehaviorObservations.paginationBug: During form data entry, MCP encountered performance delays (likely due to SAP UI5 rendering overhead on the MCP server side). This is not a SAP behavior issue but a test environment constraint.

patchDetails.rationale: SAP Fiori shell bar search button uses HTML title attribute, not accessible name. CSS selector is more reliable.

escalationReason: This is an AUTOMATION_BUG (wrong locator strategy in script), not an APP_DEFECT (SAP behavior violation). The fix is straightforward and within the scripting layer. No need to log a Jira defect against SAP.
